operation.security: projectApiKey HTTP Bearer: whole live exact-project key with BOTH documents:read and documents:write and no database restriction; not organization key/JWT/cookie
operation.request: {user_id: canonical uppercase ULID, claims?: {roles?: string[]|null}|null}; no unknown members at either level
operation.roles: 0..64 entries; nonblank; <=128 UTF-16 code units; no char.IsControl; ordinal deduplication by producer
operation.success: 200 application/json {access_token:string ASCII compact JWT <=8192 bytes, token_type:Bearer, expires_in:int64 1..900}; capped at key expiry; no refresh/lifetime request parameter

errors.400: nested error invalid_request; malformed/unknown/oversized request or signed JWT
errors.401: nested error unauthorized; missing/foreign/org/narrowed/insufficient/revoked/expired/tampered key or broken linkage; WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="ts-auth"
errors.429: OAuth flat error rate_limited; Retry-After seconds; shared token IP budget plus1000/minute per key

operation.retry: none; every mint sent once even if Retry-After is present
operation.revocation: key revocation stops future issuance; offline JWTs survive until expiry plus validation clock skew
operation.claims: server fixes typ at+jwt, ES256, iss/aud, token_kind=end_user, sub=user_id, project_id=instance_id=route project and roles; no scope/database/org_id/platform_role grant; no account provisioning
